item.title: How to Manage Overheads in Padel – Zones, Shot Selection, Intention and Direction
item.description: Padel overheads are nothing like tennis smashes. In tennis, you see a lob and simply try to finish the point. In padel, every floating ball forces a three-part decision: which overhead to play, where to strike it from on your side, and with what direction and intention. Between the bandeja, víbora, rulo, gancho, remate and the cheeky amago, you’re managing time, position and pressure rather than just power.

item.title: Walking the Leadership Ledge: Tess Fyalka on Courage, Authenticity, and Team Alignment (MDE646)
item.description: In this episode of Minter Dialogue, Tess Fyalka joins Minter Dial to explore the journey of stepping into leadership—what she calls “walking the leadership ledge.” They dive deep into the challenges new leaders face, from managing team dynamics and navigating organizational politics to building confidence and resilience. If you want real, actionable insights on leading with curiosity, authenticity, and courage, this conversation is a must-listen.

item.title: The One Thing Better Padel Players Do That Many Aren’t Doing

item.title: Cortisol, Creativity, and Connection: Justin Hai’s Blueprint for Reclaiming Rest and Reducing Stress (MDE647)
item.description: In this episode of Minter Dialogue, Minter Dial chats with entrepreneur Justin Hai, author of Stress Nation. They dive into the impact of technology on stress and sleep, the misunderstood role of cortisol, and how forming routines can help reclaim well-being. Justin Hai shares personal stories, practical advice, and insights from his company Rebalance Health. Discover why joy, boundaries, and living in the moment are key to thriving in today's fast-paced world.

item.title: Puttin’ in the Fridge: The Cold Truth About Padel Tactics
item.description: Padel has given birth to a wonderfully absurd tactic called “the fridge.” In a foursome, if one player is clearly stronger, some opponents simply pretend they don’t exist. Every ball goes to the weaker partner, who feels gloriously important, while the better player stands there, slowly defrosting on the side. item.title: Shaping Culture and Brand: Peter Tonagh on Leadership, Transformation, and AI Adoption (MDE648)
item.description: In this episode of Minter Dialogue, Peter Tonagh shares insights from his unique journey from consultancy to media leadership, emphasizing the power of purpose-driven work, authentic culture, and the transformative potential of AI in business. Hear actionable leadership lessons, the importance of customer experience, and why embracing AI risk is essential for future success.
